image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a dilapidated prison cell interior. The foreground features a heavy, rusted iron barred gate set into a crumbling concrete and plaster wall with peeling paint. Through the bars, a sunlit corridor or courtyard is visible in the background, showing more structural elements and hints of vegetation. The lighting is high-contrast, emphasizing the texture of the decay.
